text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the central plaza, I ran into Zenno Rob Roy reading.
Several books were piled up beside her.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"During my break, I went on a bookstore crawl.
I managed to get lots of books I've been wanting♪"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Fufu, which one should I read next?♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It looks like Zenno Rob Roy thoroughly enjoyed her day off!
